_doc: Combat value of a spell an item casts in combat, for the gear advisor's proc scorer (service advice). Items declare <props>combatcast</props>; ga_score computes procScore = SUM value(spell) * chance/100 * count * (itemLevel/_level_ref) * _global, superseding the flat +50. Value is expressed in expected-damage units at _level_ref. A CLEAN DAMAGE NUKE carries NO entry here: its value is derived automatically from its <tier> (spell_proc_tier_value) discounted by _save_factor -- retune a tier in the skill XML and the score follows, no table to maintain. Only spells whose real worth does NOT follow their tier carry an explicit override below: %HP or HP-of-wearer damage, multi-hit, damage-over-time, alignment-gated anti-evil (the scorer is blind to the wearer's alignment, so these get a population-weighted value), and tierless effect/buff/heal spells (a self-heal negates the opponent's DPS; already carries a ~0.75 over-heal discount). _global maps expected-damage to gear-score currency (calibrated so fireball is unchanged from the old table); _level_ref is the reference item level; _save_factor is the average damage kept after a target's saving throw, applied to tier-derived values only (overrides already bake in their own save reality). See COMBAT_PROC_SCORING.md.
